_what: Where Home's parts read and write the person's own data. Nothing here names a person's database: each read names a role (notices, goals, messages, open_work), and the role's connection name comes from the person's own records, the workspace_records row labelled `roles_label` in the database `roles_credential`, shaped {roles: {<role>: {credential_name, table}}} (the same record the Messages screen reads; written by an upsert that keeps the other roles). With no such row every part shows its empty words. decisions are not read here yet: the decisions owner (tool:see-my-decisions) answers them once its answer shape is wired in. Every statement is run by `tool` with statement_timeout_ms, so no read holds a database. home_goals is the person's goals table; it is made by `goals.create` on the first goal written and a read before that finds no goals.
roles_sql: select value from public.workspace_records where label = $1

notices.sql: select id, title, left(body, 400) as body, made_at from public.notices where kind = 'needs-you' and read_at is null order by made_at desc limit $1

open_work.sql: select id, job, trigger, started_at from public.job_runs where finished_at is null order by started_at desc limit $1

goals.create: create table if not exists home_goals (id text primary key, title text not null, now_text text, after_text text, why_it_matters text, needle_mover boolean not null default false, created_at timestamptz not null default now())
goals.select: select id, title, now_text, after_text, why_it_matters, needle_mover from home_goals order by created_at desc limit $1
goals.insert: insert into home_goals (id, title, now_text, after_text, why_it_matters) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
